# OrderFlow

OrderFlow is a free order manager for agency and mediator workflows. It tracks marketplace orders, reviews, and refunds.

- Site: https://orderflow-manager.vercel.app/
- Demo: https://orderflow-manager.vercel.app/demo
- Contact: https://orderflow-manager.vercel.app/contact
- Price: free (INR 0). No credit card.

## What it does

- Order dashboard for Flipkart, Amazon, Meesho, Myntra, and other marketplaces
- Review and refund status tracking
- Mediator message and refund-form link storage
- Excel import and CSV or JSON export
- Telegram order lookup

## FAQ

Is OrderFlow free?
Yes. Create an account with no credit card. There is no paid plan in the app today.

Who is it for?
People who handle review-based orders through agencies and mediators, not a general warehouse system.

What can I track?
Order status from ordered through delivery, review, refund form, and payment received, plus mediator messages.

Can I try it first?
Yes. The live demo is on this site, with sample orders and no account required.

How do I get help?
Email, Telegram, Discord, and WhatsApp are listed on the Contact page. You do not need an account to open it.
